record: OpenHands oauthlib 4.0.0 security relock, native integration receipt
purpose: Clear GHSA-hj66-6f7g-4r5v and GHSA-xpv3-w29h-x7cv from the live OpenHands recipe lock by moving oauthlib 3.3.1 to 4.0.0, their first patched release, and delete their expired ordinary ignores (ignoreUntil 2026-10-13), their IGNORE_SCOPES rows and the lock's IGNORE_ALLOWED_LOCKS entry, which from 2026-10-13T00:00Z failed the required osv-scanner check on every run
authorization: Command-center incident brief for one foundation-lane PR (2026-10-13): relock the OpenHands recipe lock onto oauthlib 4.0.0 through its own documented process, delete both expired oauthlib ignores once the Lumibot lock is confirmed outside the ordinary scan, and leave the hash-bound Lumibot lock unchanged

moved_pins.reason: First patched release for GHSA-hj66-6f7g-4r5v (CVE-2026-49264, >= 0.6.1, <= 3.3.1) and GHSA-xpv3-w29h-x7cv (CVE-2026-49265, >= 3.0.0, < 4.0.0), GitHub advisory records read 2026-10-13; OSV PYSEC-2026-4113 and PYSEC-2026-4114 give the same fixed version

reproduction.command: uv lock --upgrade-package anyio==4.14.2 --upgrade-package click==8.5.0 --upgrade-package pypdf==6.19.0 --upgrade-package soupsieve==2.9.2 --upgrade-package pyjwt==2.15.0 --upgrade-package urllib3==2.8.0 --upgrade-package litellm==1.93.2 --upgrade-package fsspec==2026.6.0 --upgrade-package multidict==6.9.1 --upgrade-package oauthlib==4.0.0
reproduction.workspace_edits: The two resolution-only edits of the earlier relocks: environments = linux x86_64 in [tool.uv], and the litellm exclude-newer-package cap and pin; the workspace's exclude-newer = "7 days" applies (UV_NO_CONFIG unset)
reproduction.uv_lock_diff: the oauthlib package entry only: version, sdist and wheel lines
reproduction.uv_change_list_delta: Updated oauthlib v3.3.1 -> v4.0.0 is the only line the new run prints that the control does not

release_choice.exclude_newer: Outside the workspace's 7-day exclude-newer window since 2026-10-05T06:01:19Z
release_choice.requires_dist: extras only: rsa and signedtoken (cryptography>=3.0.0, pyjwt<3,>=2.0.0), signals (blinker>=1.4.0); the lock requests no oauthlib extra
release_choice.release_notes: oauthlib v4.0.0 (tag commit 145a9a4690cb4d9de30d15fcc2984e34c49df741, published 2026-09-28T08:39:03Z) lists two breaking changes, JSONP removed from the token revocation endpoint (#951) and grant_type validated before client authentication across grants (#919, #920), and the PKCE comparison fix (#963); Python 3.8 is dropped
release_choice.scope: oauthlib only. The plan recorded in research.md and #518 also moved PyJWT to 2.15.1; that half is deferred to its own change, and PyJWT stays at 2.15.0, for which the scan lists no advisory

install_check.limits: Recipe install/import integration on the host network; no model request, image build or container acceptance

upstream_tests.what: requests-oauthlib 2.0.0's own five test modules (unchanged upstream test code from the sdist whose sha256 b3dffaebd884d8cd778494369603a9e7b58d29111bf6b41bdc2dcd87203af4e9 the lock lists), in venvs built from each tree's hashed lock plus pytest 9.1.1, requests-mock 1.12.1 and mock 5.2.0 installed against a freeze of the lock install (additions only); the repeat on the real lock that research.md and #518 planned
upstream_tests.failure_kind: assertAlmostEqual of expires_at to 2 places against the wall clock; the same two failed under both oauthlib versions here and in the 2026-09-30 pre-check (relock-2026-09-30.txt section J)

importer_review.limits: Static text search of single-line import statements in the relocked venv; not a runtime trace

osv.installed_as: security-scan.yml's install step: release download of osv-scanner_linux_amd64 and sha256sum --check

before.preflight: Ran 23 tests, FAILED (failures=1): FrozenScanTests.test_the_ordinary_config_has_no_exception_for_a_frozen_advisory, ignoreUntil has expired for both oauthlib ignores

unused_ignores_reported.note: OSV-Scanner reports the nltk and setuptools ignores as unused: no ordinary input pins those versions since the Lumibot lockchecks left the inventory. Pre-existing; not changed here

output_refs.sanitization: Only the scratch, checkout and home paths are replaced; native reports, arguments and partitions are preserved

ci_failure.log_read: 38326740785, osv-scanner job: FrozenScanTests.test_the_ordinary_config_has_no_exception_for_a_frozen_advisory failed with 'GHSA-hj66-6f7g-4r5v: ignoreUntil has expired' and 'GHSA-xpv3-w29h-x7cv: ignoreUntil has expired'; Ran 23 tests, FAILED (failures=1), exit code 1
ci_failure.limits: One log read; the other two runs' conclusions are from gh run list

lumibot_lock.inventory_class: excluded (neither the ordinary scan nor the frozen-evidence report), since the 2026-10-06 ruling recorded in evidence/receipts/osv-captured-lumibot-lockchecks-20261005.json
lumibot_lock.note: The brief expected the lock in the frozen set; it is excluded instead, which also keeps it out of the ordinary scan, so the ignores were deleted rather than renewed. No workflow scans it; the exclusion's own condition (restore scanning before any replay, adoption or new consuming route) still applies

tests.timezone: UTC (the runner's zone; the ignore expiry is date-based)

broad.modules: the 19 test modules git grep -l openhands -- 'tests/test_*.py' names, plus tests.test_wsl_retrieval, tests.test_workflow_security_coverage, tests.test_starred_convergence and tests.test_ecosystem_manifest (23)

failed_attempts.cause: The lock's libtmux 0.53.0 registers a pytest11 plugin (libtmux = libtmux.pytest_plugin) that pytest 9.1.1 rejects at startup ('Marks cannot be applied to fixtures'), in both venvs; the retained run adds -p no:libtmux

A git archive extraction of 738fdf70 has no .git, so tests.test_wsl_retrieval.RetiredRunnerTests cannot list tracked files and fails beside the expected FrozenScanTests failure; the retained before run uses a git clone --shared of the same commit

not_covered: The agent-server image's server binary, a PyInstaller build of upstream's unchanged uv.lock (sha256 d13a41b86c48e66e1719b19d8e2d3a315abfab87c257fb18881ce4e31075c910, oauthlib 3.3.1), and the grader venv keep their own locks; the inventory scans neither
No OpenHands task ran with the relocked venv; an installation that recorded the old lock digest must re-run install before the next run
OSV results hold for the scan time only: an advisory published later for any pinned package fails the required check again
overturn: OSV lists an advisory for oauthlib 4.0.0 that only a later release fixes; an OpenHands run of the recipe fails with oauthlib 4.0.0 and passes with 3.3.1; a scanned lock pins oauthlib below 4.0.0 again (relock it; an ignore needs its own reachability review); or upstream's workspace publishes a lock with oauthlib 4.0.0 or later (the next relock follows that lock)
